title: Microsoft Edge: in-context site troubleshooting controls for broken websites
notes: claim 59: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap details and existing tracking prevention controls are supported, and the briefing appropriately leaves the new prompt's default, licensing and administrative controls unconfirmed. Two descriptive statements go beyond the evidence: troubleshooting without leaving the page, and users noticing the feature only when a site breaks.

claims.claim: This roadmap item concerns Microsoft Edge website compatibility and site troubleshooting controls.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls

claims.claim: The planned experience lets users fix website problems without leaving the page.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Edge site troubleshooting prompts "without leaving" website. Read the roadmap description and Tracking prevention in Microsoft Edge; neither promises that completing troubleshooting keeps the user on the current page.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with: "Microsoft Edge plans to help users resolve website issues directly from the browser."

claims.claim: When a site misbehaves, the planned experience may guide users to tracking prevention settings, including Strict mode.
claims.quote: When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode)

claims.claim: The planned troubleshooting options include reviewing site-specific configurations.
claims.quote: and reviewing site-specific configurations.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans in-context actions intended to avoid navigating deep into settings.
claims.quote: This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

claims.claim: Strict tracking prevention trades website compatibility for maximum privacy and can cause sites to malfunction.
